# 1 Chronicles Chapter 14 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 378r–378v

---

**14:1** And-sent Chiram king of-Tsor [Tyre] messengers [mal'akhim] to David, and-timbers of-cedars [atsei arazim], and-craftsmen of-walls [chareshei qir] and-craftsmen of-wood [chareshei etsim], to-build for-him a-house [bayit].

**14:2** And-knew [vayyeda] David that YHWH had-established-him [hekhino] as-king over Yisra'el, for his-kingdom was-exalted [nisse'ah] upward [le-ma'alah] for-the-sake of his-people Yisra'el.

**14:3** And-took David more wives in-Yerushalayim, and-David fathered more sons and-daughters. **14:4** And-these [are] the-names of-the-children [ha-yeladim] who were to-him in-Yerushalayim: Shammua, and-Shovav, Natan, and-Shelomoh, **14:5** and-Yivchar, and-Elishua, and-Elpalet, **14:6** and-Nogah, and-Nefeg, and-Yafia, **14:7** and-Elishama, and-Be'elyada, and-Elifalet.

**14:8** And-heard the-Pelishtim that David had-been-anointed [nimshach] as-king over all Yisra'el, and-went-up all the-Pelishtim to-seek [le-vaqqesh] David. And-heard David, and-went-out before-them [lifneyhem].

**14:9** And-the-Pelishtim came and-spread-themselves [vayyifshetu] in-the-valley [emeq] of-Refa'im. **14:10** And-inquired [vayyish'al] David of-God, saying: Shall-I-go-up against the-Pelishtim, and-will-you-give-them into-my-hand? And-said YHWH to-him: Go-up, and-I-will-give-them into-your-hand. **14:11** And-they-went-up to-Ba'al-Peratsim, and-struck-them [vayyakkem] David there. And-said David: God has-broken-through [parats] my-enemies by-my-hand, like-a-breaking-through [ke-ferets] of-waters [mayim]. Therefore they-called the-name of-that place Ba'al-Peratsim.

**14:12** And-they-left [vayyaazvu] there their-gods [eloheyhem], and-said David, and-they-were-burned [vayyissarfu] in-the-fire [ba-esh].

**14:13** And-again [vayyosifu] the-Pelishtim and-spread-themselves in-the-valley. **14:14** And-inquired [vayyish'al] David again [od] of-God, and-said to-him God: You-shall-not go-up after-them; turn-around [hasev] from-upon-them, and-come to-them from-opposite [mi-mul] the-balsam-trees [ha-bekha'im]. **14:15** And-it-shall-be when-you-hear the-sound [qol] of-the-marching [ha-tse'adah] in-the-tops [be-rashei] of-the-balsam-trees, then you-shall-go-out to-the-battle [ba-milchamah], for has-gone-out God [ha-Elohim] before-you to-strike the-camp of-the-Pelishtim.

**14:16** And-did David as God [Elohim] commanded-him, and-they-struck the-camp of-the-Pelishtim from-Giv'on and-unto Gezer. **14:17** And-went-out the-name [shem] of-David in-all the-lands [ha-aratsot], and-YHWH put [natan] his-dread [pachdo] upon all the-nations [ha-goyim].

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.2 — nisse'ah le-ma'alah:** "Exalted upward" — a double emphasis on elevation. David's kingdom rises both politically and theologically. The phrase *for the sake of his people* clarifies that kingship serves the people, not the king.

**v.11 — Ba'al-Peratsim:** "Master/Lord of breakthroughs" — the wordplay on *parats* (to break through) connects directly to the *Perets-Uzza* disaster of ch. 13. The same God who "broke out" (*parats*) against Uzzah now "breaks through" (*parats*) against David's enemies. The root is the same; the difference is proper alignment with divine will.

**v.12 — vayyissarfu ba-esh:** "And they were burned in the fire" — the Chronicler changes 2 Samuel 5:21, where David "carried them away" (*vayyissa'em*). The Chronicler has David burn the Philistine gods, conforming to the Deuteronomic law (Deut 7:5, 25).

**v.14-15 — ha-bekha'im:** "The balsam trees" — the species is uncertain (*bekha* may relate to weeping). The sound of marching in the treetops signals divine intervention — God's invisible army advances above and ahead of David's forces.

*— EMET*
